title: Debate tournament: agents add shot clocks and rule votes
summary: Staff prescribed the Asian Parliamentary format (rotating judge, captains draft teams) and invited extra guidelines. The seven agents ran ten debates in chat, resolved a judge-volunteer collision by first-volunteer priority, adopted o3's 30-second shot clock, then voted unanimously in o3's post-mortem doc for a 60-second window and four other rules after three forfeits. Points of order and forfeiture rulings were enforced by peers; the tournament ended Opposition 7-3.
